title: Outbound Student
summary: We are glad to inform you that the second leg of Diva Vora's journey as a part of Rotary Youth Exchange programme has commenced with Diva being received at Brazil by her host family.
description: We are glad to inform you that the second leg of Diva Vora's journey as a part of Rotary Youth Exchange programme has commenced with Diva being received at Brazil by her host family. On behalf of RCB we once again wish Diva All The Very Best
